title: POST /api/task/<item-id>/<action> request bodies
description: One def per endpoint, named after it (hyphens become underscores). Every POST sends Content-Type application/json, header X-Todoimpl-Token (CSRF, from the page's meta tag) and a same-origin Origin. Answer: response.schema.json.

auto_ship.description: Start/Restart only: ship without a Ship click once every check is green (done_check notes). Omitted (Retry, Hand back): keep the run's stored choice.

start.description: Start the next stage chain (Spec or Plan).

answers.description: Question id (Q1..) to answer text; may be partial.

send.description: Send to Claude. `images` item N is `[Image #N]` in the text; the server copies each into the run dir and names its path in the note (T2320). With images the request may be up to 40 MB.

image_refs.description: Numbered images ([Image #N] is item N) for send and new_task, at most 8.

image_ref.description: One png, jpeg, webp or gif (the server reads its first bytes): an id POST /api/upload answered (the page, at most 10 MB, ids distinct), or the bytes inline (the phone through the relay, at most 6 MB decoded).

ship.description: Ship click (none offered since T2060; a card ships itself): rebase, recheck, commit, push, close note.

close.description: Close click (a closing run held at the gate; the board offers none since T2060): re-run the done_check, then close_task.

go.description: Go click on a permission block: runs the card's one-line command as kuhy, reruns the stage on exit 0.

rerun.description: Done, rerun: kuhy ran the command himself.

wont.description: Won't do: cancel a resting run and abandon every note behind the card (T2045).

done_manually.description: Done manually: stop the run, close every note behind the card as done, rest the card in Done (T2064).

model.description: Model picker (modelswitch): pin the card to a model, or drop the pin with `default`; its current stage runs again on it (a live turn is cut and resumed on it).

credits_fallback.description: POST /api/settings/credits-fallback (not task-scoped): turn the free API credits fallback on or off for every run.

new_task.description: POST /api/new-task (not task-scoped): kuhy's own task. The server writes the images (`[Image #N]` above each link, T2321) and moves the staged files (POST /api/upload, at most 500 MB together) to a fresh dufs folder, appends a `## title` section linking them to the repo's open note (or a new note), then presses Start on the repo card. The request may be up to 40 MB.

files.description: Ids POST /api/upload answered, in the order the note links them. Any file type.

ask_answer.description: POST /api/task/<id>/ask/answer: click one option of a choice.

ask_take_recommended.description: POST .../ask/take-recommended: every open choice takes its recommended option.

ask_run.description: POST .../ask/run: run the command (add true: add the exact string to the allow-list first). Answer {ok, result: {exit, tail, capped}}.

ask_reject.description: POST .../ask/reject: reject a screenshot; the session gets the card back.
